answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The opal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the velvet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work.
